name: vessel-feature-complete
description: Complete feature implementation workflow for a vessel with tests, documentation, quality checks, and PR creation

tasks.description: Analyze feature requirements and check for existing similar code

prompt.template:
You are implementing the feature: {{featureName}}

Description: {{featureDescription}}

First, search for similar existing functionality:
1. Use metabob_search_codebase_issues to find related code
2. Read relevant files to understand patterns
3. Identify what can be reused vs. what needs to be new
4. Document your analysis

Then create an implementation plan:
- List files that need changes
- Identify new files to create
- Note any breaking changes
- Estimate complexity

Output: A clear implementation plan with file list and approach.

variables.name: featureName
variables.description: Name of the feature to implement

variables.name: featureDescription
variables.description: Detailed description of what the feature should do

tasks.description: Implement the feature with proper error handling and logging

prompt.template:
Implement the feature: {{featureName}}

Follow the implementation plan from task-1.

Requirements:
1. Write clean, readable code following project conventions
2. Add proper error handling
3. Include logging for important operations
4. Handle edge cases
5. Make it extensible for future changes

Best practices:
- Follow existing code patterns in this vessel
- Use type hints (Python) or TypeScript types
- Keep functions focused and small
- Extract reusable logic into helpers

After implementation:
1. Run metabob_search_codebase_issues to find issues in your changes
2. Fix all HIGH severity issues immediately
3. Document why you made key design decisions using metabob_annotate_component

tasks.description: Write comprehensive tests for the feature

prompt.template:
Write comprehensive tests for: {{featureName}}

Test requirements:
1. Unit tests for all functions/methods
2. Integration tests for the full feature flow
3. Edge case tests (empty input, invalid data, etc.)
4. Error handling tests
5. At least 80% code coverage for new code

Test structure:
- Use descriptive test names (test_should_do_X_when_Y)
- Use fixtures/mocks appropriately
- Test both happy path and error cases
- Include docstrings explaining what's being tested

Run the tests:
1. Execute the test suite
2. Verify all tests pass
3. Check coverage report
4. Fix any failures

tasks.description: Update documentation and add inline comments

prompt.template:
Update documentation for: {{featureName}}

Documentation tasks:
1. Add/update function docstrings with:
   - What the function does
   - Parameters and types
   - Return value and type
   - Raises (errors that can be thrown)
   - Examples if complex

2. Update README or relevant docs:
   - Add feature to feature list
   - Provide usage examples
   - Note any breaking changes
   - Update API documentation

3. Add inline comments:
   - Explain WHY, not WHAT
   - Document non-obvious decisions
   - Explain complex algorithms

4. Update CHANGELOG:
   - Add entry under 'Unreleased' section
   - Use format: '- feat: {{featureName}} - {{featureDescription}}'

tasks.description: Run quality checks and fix all critical issues

prompt.template:
Run quality checks for: {{featureName}}

1. Metabob quality scan:
   - Run metabob_get_priority_issues
   - Fix all HIGH severity issues in your changes
   - Fix MEDIUM issues if time permits
   - For each fix, call metabob_mark_problem_complete with detailed notes

2. Impact analysis:
   - Use metabob_analyze_change_impact on changed functions
   - Check if changes affect other vessels: {{affectedVessels}}
   - If yes, note what needs coordination

3. Related changes check:
   - Use metabob_suggest_related_changes
   - Review suggested files for similar patterns
   - Update them if the same pattern should be applied

4. Code annotations:
   - Use metabob_annotate_component on 3-5 key components
   - Document WHY they were designed this way
   - Note alternatives considered
   - Explain tradeoffs made

variables.name: affectedVessels
variables.description: List of vessels affected by this change

tasks.description: Create organized git commits with descriptive messages

prompt.template:
Create git commits for: {{featureName}}

Commit strategy:
1. Organize changes into logical commits:
   - Implementation commit
   - Tests commit
   - Documentation commit
   - (Optional) Refactoring commit if you improved existing code

2. Commit message format:
   ```
   type(scope): short description
   
   Longer explanation:
   - Why this change was needed
   - What alternatives were considered
   - Any important implementation details
   ```

3. Types:
   - feat: New feature
   - test: Adding tests
   - docs: Documentation
   - refactor: Code restructuring

4. Scope: Use vessel name (e.g., 'api', 'cli', 'opencode')

5. Example:
   ```
   feat(api): add user profile endpoints
   
   Implements GET/PUT/DELETE for /api/users/:id/profile.
   Uses existing auth middleware for access control.
   Includes validation for profile fields.
   ```

Create the commits now using git add and git commit.

{{#if createPR}}Create a pull request for: {{featureName}}

1. Ensure branch is up to date:
   - git fetch origin develop
   - Rebase if needed: git rebase origin/develop
   - Resolve any conflicts

2. Push branch:
   - git push origin HEAD

3. Create PR using gh CLI:
   ```bash
   gh pr create \
     --title "feat: {{featureName}}" \
     --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
   ## Summary
   {{featureDescription}}
   
   ## Changes
   - Implemented {{featureName}} functionality
   - Added comprehensive tests (unit + integration)
   - Updated documentation and examples
   - Fixed all HIGH severity code quality issues
   
   ## Testing
   - ✓ All existing tests pass
   - ✓ New tests added with 80%+ coverage
   - ✓ Manually tested in development environment
   
   ## Quality Checks
   - ✓ No HIGH severity Metabob issues
   - ✓ Code reviewed with metabob_analyze_change_impact
   - ✓ Design decisions documented with annotations
   
   {{#if affectedVessels}}
   ## Affected Vessels
   This change may affect: {{affectedVessels}}
   Coordination activities may be needed.
   {{/if}}
   
   ## Checklist
   - [x] Tests pass
   - [x] Documentation updated
   - [x] Commit messages follow convention
   - [x] No merge conflicts with develop
   EOF
   )" \
     --base develop
   ```

4. Output the PR URL
{{else}}Skipping PR creation (createPR=false)

The feature is complete and committed. To create a PR later:
```bash
git push origin HEAD
gh pr create --base develop
```
{{/if}}

variables.description: Whether to create a PR automatically
